what_happened: An operator hand-merged PR #149 (job 20261018-145008-k7fq) as commit 02837e0, going around `athena land`. The merge added docs/spec.toml, xtask/tests/spec.rs and their doc entries, and also carried two hand changes: a verifier timeout of 2400 s and a relative reading-inputs digest test. The full history check then failed on 02837e0, so no pull request could pass. On 2026-10-19 Sri chose to revert the job's content. On 2026-10-23 Sri approved adding 02837e0 to [history] exempt. The operator reverted the spec content and kept the two hand changes. The operator also added the exemption and left the job's records in place, because records are append-only. The spec is to re-land through Athena.
cause: Nothing stops a pull request from being merged outside `athena land`. The history check only runs after the merge, and it fails for every later pull request. Because the merge was possible and was done by hand, the operator had to revert and exempt the commit. The hand merge also bundled unrelated changes with the job's content, which made the revert partial. Provenance rules are enforced late rather than at the merge point.
prevention: Enforce the land path at the merge point. Add a required PR status check, or branch protection, that blocks merging a job's pull request unless `athena land` produced it. Run the full history check on the PR branch before merge so a bypass shows up as a red PR rather than a poisoned main. Make operator hand changes go through their own small job or PR, separate from a job's content. Add a documented `athena land --adopt` or exempt command so an unavoidable hand merge is excused in one logged step.
proposed_request: Make it impossible to merge a job's pull request around `athena land`. Outcome: a pull request from an Athena job cannot be merged into main unless `athena land` landed it. The full history check runs on the PR before merge, so a hand merge is blocked or shows red up front rather than breaking every later pull request. Acceptance: (1) a test shows a job PR merged without `athena land` is reported as failing the pre-merge check; (2) a test shows a PR landed via `athena land` passes; (3) the [history] exempt list is changed only through a logged Athena command, with the reason recorded. Also re-land the spec (docs/spec.toml and xtask/tests/spec.rs) through Athena as a new job, keeping the verifier timeout at 2400 s and the relative reading-inputs digest test.
